description: Run a Home Assistant action (formerly a service call): light.turn_on, climate.set_temperature, media_player.volume_set, script.turn_on. Answers once it has run, with the states that changed. An action in a domain the user approves call by call (lock, alarm_control_panel, cover, valve unless configured otherwise), aimed at an entity of one, or a homeassistant action aimed wider than named entities, is refused here with needs_confirmation: use call_action_confirmed. An action Home Assistant runs only for administrators (every reload, homeassistant.restart and the like) is refused with needs_admin, without being sent, when this token's user is not one. Sent once: if the answer is outcome_unknown, read the entities (get_states) before running it again. Only what the user asks for: these act on a home.

data.description: The action's fields, as list_actions shows them: {"brightness_pct": 40}, {"temperature": 21.5}. Not the target.

domain.description: The action's domain: light, switch, climate, lock, script, homeassistant, ...

return_response.description: Ask for the data the action answers with (a weather forecast, a calendar's events); only for actions list_actions marks with response.

service.description: The action within the domain: turn_on, set_temperature, unlock, ... (list_actions lists them).

target.description: What the action acts on. Several kinds may be combined; an action that takes no target (homeassistant.reload_all, a script) leaves it out.

area_id.description: One area id (list_areas) or a list of them.

device_id.description: One device id (list_areas) or a list of them.

entity_id.description: One entity id (or all, for every entity of the domain) or a list of them.

floor_id.description: One floor id or a list of them.

label_id.description: One label id or a list of them.

name: call_action
title: Run an action
